setup: You are summing the interior angles of a polygon with \([[sides]]\) sides.

steps.say: Drawing the diagonals from one vertex cuts the polygon into \([[sides]] - 2\) triangles, and together they account for every interior angle exactly once.
Each triangle contributes 180 degrees, so the sum is \(180 \times ([[sides]] - 2)\), which is a single multiplication once the triangle count is known.

answer: So the interior angles of the polygon sum to \([[sum]]\) degrees.
